§5.17 Barnes’ G-Function (Double Gamma Function)

ⓘ
Keywords:
Barnes’ G-function, Glaisher’s constant, asymptotic expansion, definition, infinite product, integral representation, recurrence relation
Notes:
See Whittaker and Watson (1927, p. 264). For (5.17.7) see Olver (1997b, p. 292) and the differentiated form of (25.4.1).
Referenced by:
§2.10(i), Erratum (V1.0.11) for References

In this equation (and in (5.17.5) below), the Ln’s have their principal values on the positive real axis and are continued via continuity, as in §4.2(i).

When z→∞ in |ph⁡z|≤π−δ(<π),

5.17.5 Ln⁡G⁡(z+1)∼14⁢z2+z⁢Ln⁡Γ⁡(z+1)−(12⁢z⁢(z+1)+112)⁢ln⁡z−ln⁡A+∑k=1∞B2⁢k+22⁢k⁢(2⁢k+1)⁢(2⁢k+2)⁢z2⁢k.
ⓘ
Symbols:
G⁡(z): Barnes’ G-function (or double gamma function), Bn: Bernoulli numbers, Γ⁡(z): gamma function, ∼: Poincaré asymptotic expansion, Ln⁡z: general logarithm function, ln⁡z: principal branch of logarithm function, k: nonnegative integer, z: complex variable and A: Glaisher’s constant
Referenced by:
§5.17, §5.17, Erratum (V1.0.7) for Equation (5.17.5), Erratum (V1.1.11) for Equation (5.17.5)
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/5.17.E5
Encodings:
TeX, pMML, png
Errata (effective with 1.1.11):
For consistency we have replaced Ln⁡z by ln⁡z.
Errata (effective with 1.0.7):
Originally the term z⁢Ln⁡Γ⁡(z+1) was incorrectly stated as z⁢Γ⁡(z+1). (This error was reported subsequently by Nick Jones on December 11, 2013.)

Reported 2013-08-01 by Gergő Nemes

See also:
Annotations for §5.17 and Ch.5

For error bounds and an exponentially-improved extension, see Nemes (2014a). Here B2⁢k+2 is the Bernoulli number (§24.2(i)), and A is Glaisher’s constant, given by

5.17.6 A=eC=1.28242 71291 00622 63687⁢…,

5.17.7 C=limn→∞(∑k=1nk⁢ln⁡k−(12⁢n2+12⁢n+112)⁢ln⁡n+14⁢n2)=γ+ln⁡(2⁢π)12−ζ′⁡(2)2⁢π2=112−ζ′⁡(−1),

For Glaisher’s constant see also Greene and Knuth (1982, p. 100) and §2.10(i).
